title: 2027 Infiniti QX60 Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Infiniti QX60 rolls into the new model year with minor packaging and content updates, after a major overhaul for 2026.
body_markdown:
Now well into a second generation that launched in 2022 and was thoroughly updated in 2026, the Infiniti QX60 is a comfortable and luxurious three-row midsize crossover SUV. The QX60 competes with big sellers such as the Acura MDX, the Audi Q7, the BMW X5, the Genesis GV80, the Lexus TX, the Lincoln Aviator, the Mercedes-Benz GLE, and the Volvo XC90.

## What’s New for the 2027 Infiniti QX60


With a new powertrain in 2025 and a comprehensive refresh in 2026, the Infiniti QX60 rolls into 2027 with a few minor packaging and content updates. It’s still offered in four trim levels: Pure, Luxe, Sport, and Autograph. Last year, the QX60 came standard with 20-inch wheels, but the base 2027 QX60 Pure now rides on 18-inch alloys.


## Design


The QX60’s boldest styling elements are its large front grille and driving lights that are shaped like "digital piano keys," according to Infiniti. Certain Sport models and all Autograph models can be ordered in two-tone paint colors with a black roof. Sport models also get more blacked-out exterior trim to go with a unique grille mesh insert.


## Powertrain


When the second-generation QX60 was launched in 2022, it came with a V6 engine. In 2025, Infiniti swapped its V6 for a turbocharged four-cylinder with a variable compression ratio for improved efficiency. While outright power dropped by 27 horsepower, torque was up by 16 pound-feet. The VC-Turbo engine remains the only powerplant offered in the 2027 QX60, and sends 268 hp and 296 lb-ft to either the front wheels or optionally to all four. A nine-speed automatic transmission is used in all trim levels. According to the EPA, the front-wheel-drive (FWD) 2027 Infiniti QX60 is rated at 22 mpg in the city, 28 mpg on the highway, and 24 mpg combined. With all-wheel drive (AWD), the QX60 gets 21 mpg city, 27 highway, and 24 combined. Properly equipped, the QX60 can tow up to 6,000 pounds, which is a solid rating for the midsize three-row luxury SUV segment.


## Interior


The 2027 QX60 has a classy, upscale cabin, with smooth lines and high-quality materials everywhere passengers are likely to touch. Pure and Luxe models can seat up to seven thanks to a second-row bench, but the Sport and Autograph come standard with second-row captain’s chairs that reduce capacity to six. QX60 Autograph models get the fanciest materials inside, with open-pore ash wood trim featuring laser-etched metal inlays, as well as semi-aniline leather with ripple stitching and perforation patterns.


## Technology


A pair of 12.3-inch digital displays are set into the QX60’s dashboard, one serving as a digital display cluster and the other as a touchscreen infotainment system. With Google built-in tech, Infiniti’s infotainment software includes Google Maps, access to the Google Play app store, and Google Assistant voice control. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are standard and Autograph models come standard with a 10.8-inch color head-up display. Luxe and Sport models feature a Klipsch audio system with 16 speakers, one of which is an 8-inch subwoofer. The QX60 Autograph gets a Klipsch Reference Premiere system with 20 speakers and a 24-channel amplifier, plus an Individual Audio system that allows the driver to listen to their own audio, including voice calls and navigation instructions, while the rest of the cabin hears a different source.

## Safety


Automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, forward-collision warning, rear automatic braking, rear cross-traffic alert, blind-spot monitors, a lane-departure warning, lane-departure prevention, and a rear sonar-based parking assist system come standard on all 2027 QX60 models. The QX60 Pure gets old-school cruise control, but all other trim levels get intelligent adaptive cruise tech, plus a driver-attention monitor and a blind-spot intervention system instead of just a monitor. In its top Autograph trim, the QX60 can be ordered with a Technology Package that includes ProPilot Assist 2.1, a semi-autonomous aid that allows for hands-off driving under certain conditions. The 2026 Infiniti QX60 earned the IIHS Top Safety Pick+ designation and, with no major changes, it’s likely to get the same for 2027. The QX60 also earned the top five-star overall safety rating from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.


## Pricing and Release Date


The Pure model wasn't listed on Infiniti’s website at the time of writing, leaving the Luxe FWD at $58,865 (including $1,575 destination fee) as the least expensive model. Adding AWD ups the price to $61,630. The 2027 QX60 Sport comes standard with AWD and starts at $63,935. The top-spec Autograph model, which is also AWD only, starts at $69,130 and the Technology Package with ProPilot Assist 2.1 adds $3,150.
